text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart came to the ocean for 
survival training to forge her mind and 
body, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Too hot. This blazing sun is brutal.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"And the sea breeze feels very heavy too. 
Hehe, this looks like it'll be quite the 
challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first we'll decide on a base 
camp and secure our food supply.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"If we keep dawdling, the sun's gonna go 
down in no time!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There's surprisingly little 
driftwood. Gathering even a single piece 
of firewood is quite a chore.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...They're not biting. Is the bait no 
good? At this rate, we won't have any 
dinner.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oops! Our water has gone down this much 
already! I was trying to be careful since 
we can't easily get more, but……"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like I ever underestimated 
coastal survival, but... To think it'd be 
like this, like this—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now this is more like it. Things are 
really heating up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Unpredictability like this really is the 
best part of survival!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For now, it'd be best to build a seawater 
distillation device and secure some water.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's look for some creatures we could use 
as bait, too. A different bait might just 
do the trick.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We might even find some edible shellfish 
while we're at it♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Also... I want to try making salt too! 
Eating freshly caught fish with handmade 
salt is the ultimate luxury, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there are so many things I want to 
try, I don't have time to be feeling down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daring Heart survived her oceanic 
ordeal. This experience carried over to 
her racing, sharpening both her 
situational analysis and decision-making.
